title: Confidence intervals for empirical convergence rates of randomised quasi-Monte Carlo, with applications to option pricing
abstract: arXiv:2502.17731v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Empirical comparisons of quasi-Monte Carlo rules often report fitted convergence exponents without intervals. We estimate the root mean square error from independent randomisations, fit its log slope over a declared sample-size window, and resample whole randomisations to construct an interval. For a fixed window, we establish asymptotic validity under finite fourth moments and a positive limiting variance. We measure coverage of four interval constructions on integrands with known exponents. With Gaussian errors, all four are compatible with nominal coverage at 128 and 512 randomisations, and jackknife-$t$ already at 32. All four undercover for the two higher-kurtosis families even at 512 randomisations. For differences between slopes, including null and small effects, preserving the dependence between paired randomisations can greatly narrow intervals, but it does not ensure nominal coverage. translated_title: 随机化拟蒙特卡洛经验收敛速率的置信区间及其在期权定价中的应用
translated_abstract: 拟蒙特卡洛规则的实证比较通常只报告拟合的收敛指数而不附带区间。我们通过独立随机化估计均方根误差，在声明的样本量窗口内拟合其对数斜率，并通过对整个随机化进行重采样来构造置信区间。对于固定窗口，我们在有限四阶矩和正极限方差的条件下证明了该方法具有渐近有效性。我们在具有已知指数的被积函数上测量了四种区间构造的覆盖率。在高斯误差下，所有四种构造在128和512次随机化时都能达到名义覆盖率，而jackknife-$t$方法在32次随机化时即可达到。对于两个高峰度分布族，即使在512次随机化时，所有四种构造均出现覆盖不足。对于斜率之间的差异（包括零效应和小效应），保留配对随机化之间的相关性可以大幅缩窄区间，但并不能保证名义覆盖率。在期权定价中，更陡的斜率和……
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于独立随机化重采样、为随机化拟蒙特卡洛拟合收敛指数构造置信区间的方法，证明其渐近有效性，通过数值实验比较多种区间构造的覆盖率，并将其应用于期权定价中的收敛率估计。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a resampling-based method to construct confidence intervals for fitted convergence exponents of randomised quasi-Monte Carlo from independent randomisations, establishes its asymptotic validity, compares the coverage of several interval constructions empirically, and applies the method to convergence-rate estimation in option pricing.
